item.title: Dr. GraphWiz at CoCreate: Advancing Open Science and Collaboration
item.description: Dr. GraphWiz recently participated in the CoCreate: Open Science workshop at Philipps-Universität Marburg 🏛️. This event convened researchers, students, and administrators to foster dialogue on the future of transparent and collaborative research practices 🤝. Key Takeaways and Contributions 🔑: Promoting Open Science: The workshop emphasized practical strategies for integrating Open Science principles into research and education, focusing on reproducibility and accessibility 📖. Showcasing Innovation: Dr. GraphWiz presented projects centered on data sovereignty and transparency, demonstrating our commitment to open and user-controlled digital environments 💡.
